message: Bundler: cooldown not written: the URL of the source call on line 1 of Gemfile is not a literal string, so depcurfew cannot tell whether it is "https://rubygems.org"
fix: If it names rubygems.org, write it as source "https://rubygems.org" on a line of its own and run depcurfew apply again, or add cooldown: 3 to that call by hand

message: Bundler: cooldown not written: the source "https://rubygems.org" call on line 3 of Gemfile is not edited, because it has a block, so it is the source of the gems in the block only; depcurfew apply edits only a plain source "https://rubygems.org" call on a line of its own
fix: Add cooldown: 3 to that call by hand (source "https://rubygems.org", cooldown: 3 do), or write it as a plain call on a line of its own and run depcurfew apply again
